notes: Photo-reading now rides out cold starts instead of failing on them. Build 53 revealed the real shape of the problem: RunPod's gateway drops the held connection with a 'network error' after about a minute of cold start — before your GPU finishes waking. Since that first request is exactly what wakes the GPU, the app now retries the dropped connection automatically inside the 3-minute window ('waking your GPU — cold start · attempt 2'), and a later attempt lands on the warm worker. You send the photo once; the app does the resending.
